title: East Blue overview
text: The story starts in East Blue where Luffy meets early crewmates and sets course for the Grand Line. Friendship, promises, and big dreams set the tone.

title: What is Haki?
text: Haki is a spiritual force with three forms: Observation (sense/anticipate), Armament (harden/infuse), and Conqueror's (overwhelm with will).

title: Devil Fruits 101
text: Devil Fruits grant unique powers but remove the ability to swim. Types include Paramecia, Zoan, and Logia.

title: Marineford key beats
text: A massive war reshapes power balances and marks turning points for many characters.

title: Who are the Yonko?
text: Yonko are top pirate captains who dominate the seas; membership has changed over time after major events.

title: World Government
text: A global organization using Marines and secret agencies whose decisions drive world affairs.

title: Wano themes
text: An alliance challenges tyranny; liberation themes and long-running threads conclude, changing regional influence.

title: Bounties explained
text: Bounties measure perceived threat and reputation rather than pure strength, guiding pursuit by authorities.
